subject: Re: Renewal & capacity bump for Q2 — pricing question
messages:
From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@bluebay.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal & capacity bump for Q2 — pricing question

Hi Neha,

Hope you're doing well. We're approaching our renewal with Redwood (renewal date: 2027-03-31) and want to talk through two items before we lock terms:

1) Capacity bump: We expect a 25–35% increase in inference volume starting in April due to a new product rollout. We want to reserve capacity to avoid latency issues.
2) Short-term price stability: given macro budget planning, we'd like a 6-month price hold on our current unit pricing (no per-token increases) while we scale.

Can you share what levers you can pull for a cross-quarter price hold (or a limited price cap), and how committed capacity and term length affect discounting or credits? Procurement will also want a one-page amendment and a pricing worksheet.

Attaching the internal forecast (BlueBay_Renewal_Redesign.xlsx) for context.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call.

— Ayesha
Ayesha Khan
VP, Platform
BlueBay Analytics

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@bluebay.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity bump for Q2 — pricing question

Hi Ayesha — thanks for the clear note and the forecast. Looping in Marissa (renewals) and Rishi (SE) to accelerate. A few quick clarifying questions before we model options:

- When you say "reserve capacity", are you looking for a reserved GPU commit (monthly) or a token/throughput target?
- Is the 25–35% uplift uniform across endpoints or concentrated on a couple of long-running routes?
- Is procurement amenable to a shorter-term amendment if it buys you immediate price stability (e.g., a 6-month price hold + a one-time credit)?

High level: we can do (A) a term extension with a higher commit for deeper discounts, or (B) a short-term price hold paired with a one-time credit and an optional follow-on true-up. I asked Marissa to draft two concrete options and a short amendment for your procurement team.

If useful, we can do a 30-minute call Wednesday.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@bluebay.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: BlueBay Analytics Procurement <procurement@bluebay.ai>, Ravi Mehta <r.mehta@bluebay.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 14:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity bump for Q2 — pricing question

Thanks Neha — answers below:

- Preferred reserved model: monthly reserved capacity (we'd like predictable GPU capacity tied to month-over-month committed tokens).
- Uplift shape: ~70% of the uplift will hit two model routes (inference / re-ranking) — not evenly distributed.
- Procurement note: they prefer a single amendment, but can accept a short-term amendment if it shortens the procurement timeline.

If you can provide a clear choice between:
  Option 1: 12-month commit increase (30% higher) with X% discount applied to committed units, OR
  Option 2: 6-month price hold on existing list pricing + one-time credit towards usage over first 3 months

Procurement specifically asked for estimated monthly charges for both options and a one-page amendment they can circulate. Please send both ASAP.

Ayesha

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@bluebay.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity bump for Q2 — pricing question

Hi Ayesha — thanks for the clear ask and the forecast. Attached are two formal options and an amendment draft. Quick summary below; full detail in attachments (Proposed_Amendment_BB.pdf, Commit_Pricing_BB.xlsx).

Option A — 12‑month commit uplift
- Commit: +30% monthly reserved capacity (applies to the two heavy routes by tag)
- Discount: 18% off current list for committed units, sustained for 12 months
- On-demand: same list pricing for overage; optional true‑up at quarter-end
- Tradeoff: requires signing a 12‑month amendment; immediate reserved capacity provisioning available

Option B — 6‑month price hold + one-time credit
- Price hold: keep current unit pricing for 6 months starting 2027-04-01 (no list increases for that window)
- Credit: one-time usage credit of $45,000 applied across first three months to offset initial scale costs
- Commit: no long-term commit required; optional reserved pool at current prices if you choose to convert later
- Tradeoff: shorter commitment, smaller immediate discount, faster procurement

Attachments: Proposed_Amendment_BB.pdf (one-page amendment), Commit_Pricing_BB.xlsx (monthly estimate for both options). HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company/contacts/BB-2027-R1

Next steps: If Option B looks best for procurement speed, I can get legal to begin an expedited amendment and generate a DocuSign link. If you prefer Option A, we'll need a PO and a 12‑month signer and we'll map the reserved pool to your tagged routes.

—Marissa Cole
Senior Renewals Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Proposed_Amendment_BB.pdf (application/pdf, 1 page); Commit_Pricing_BB.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@bluebay.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluebay.ai, Ravi Mehta <r.mehta@bluebay.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 16:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity bump for Q2 — pricing question

Hi Marissa / Neha — thanks, Option B works best for BlueBay given procurement timing. We'll proceed with the 6-month price hold + $45k credit. Can you: 

1) Send the one-page amendment to procurement and legal as DocuSign (procurement@bluebay.ai; cc Ravi),
2) Include the Commit_Pricing_BB.xlsx as an appendix so finance can see the monthly estimates, and
3) Confirm when reserved capacity can be provisioned if we decide to convert to a committed pool mid-term.

If legal needs anything from our side, loop Ravi. We hope to have execution by 1/28 to hit operational provisioning by 4/1.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Ayesha
Attachments referenced: SOW_v2.pdf (for later), BlueBay_Renewal_Redesign.xlsx (already shared)
